Midnight Season 1 Raids - Dreamrift, Voidspire, March on Quel'Danas and Sporefall

Last Updated: Jun 4, 2026 - 7:45 PM (4mo ago)
Neryssa

Midnight Season 1 is split into four raids: The Dreamrift, The Voidspire, March on Quel'Danas and Sporefall. With 10 bosses in total between all three raids, the Season 1 storyline is hitting from multiple ends!

Table of Contents
1. New in Patch 12.0.72. Midnight Season 1 Raids3. Midnight Season 1 Raid Backstories4. How to Enter the Raids5. Raid Bosses6. Loot7. Raid Rewards and Achievements8. The Great Vault and Raid Slots
1.

New in Patch 12.0.7

Patch 12.0.7 releases the Sporefall raid. This is a one-boss raid that drops increased item level loot and is the first raid in all of World of Warcraft that features a flex composition even in Mythic difficulty.

Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.

2.

Midnight Season 1 Raids

Season 1 of Midnight features four raids players can progress on: The Dreamrift, the Voidspire, March on Quel'Danas and Sporefall. These raids, when combined, tell the story of the first patch of the Midnight expansion, as well as some separate storylines.

3.

Midnight Season 1 Raid Backstories

In Season 1 Midnight, two raids have a connected storyline (Voidspire and March on Quel'Danas), while the two remaining raids are 1-boss raids with a separate storyline.

3.1.

The Dreamrift

The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave Haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.

3.2.

The Voidspire and March on Quel'Danas

From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.

Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the Blood Elves is lost forever.

The minimum required item level for Raid Finder is 220 for Dreamrift and Voidspire, 227 for March on Quel'Danas, and 240 for Sporefall.

4.

How to Enter the Raids

Each of the four raids are located in a different zone: Dreamrift and Sporefall are located in Harandar, Voidspire is located in Voidstorm, and March on Quel'Danas is located in Isle of Quel'Danas.

Here's coordinate entrances for all four Midnight Season 1 raids:

  • The Dreamrift entrance: /way #2413 61.69 62.77 Dreamrift Entrance
  • The Voidspire entrance: /way #2405 45.05 64.71 Voidspire Entrance
  • March on Quel'Danas entrance: /way #2424 52.61 85.75 March on Quel'Danas Entrance
  • Sporefall entrance: /way #2413 73.48 66.35 Sporefall Entrance
5.

Raid Bosses

Here's a list of bosses face in the four raids of Season 1 of Midnight.

  • The Dreamrift
    • Chimaerus the Undreamt God.
  • The Voidspire
    1. Imperator Averzian
    2. Vorasius
    3. Fallen-King Salhadaar
    4. Vaelgor and Ezzorak
    5. Lightblinded Vanguard
    6. Crown of the Cosmos
  • March on Quel'Danas
    1. Belo'ren, Child of A'lar
    2. Midnight Falls
  • Sporefall
    • Rotmire
6.

Loot

Group Loot is the only method of loot distribution in all Midnight raids. There is no option to return to Personal Loot. Certain items like professional reagents may still use Personal Loot where appropriate.

6.1.

Loot Trading

All item-level restrictions placed on trading between members of your raid group are entirely removed. while inside any Midnight raids, allowing you to trade items with small item level increases that are not upgraded (rings, necklaces).

6.2.

Loot Item Levels

In the Midnight Season 1 raids, loot item levels scale with difficulty, from Raid Finder up to Mythic. Bosses drop gear within specific item level ranges, and the further you progress, the higher the item levels will be. The item levels below apply to the Dreamrift, Voidspire, and March on Quel'Danas raids.

  • "Boss 1" is Imperator Averzian.
  • "Boss 2-3" are Vorasius, Fallen-King Salhadaar, and Chimaerus.
  • "Boss 4-5" are Vaelgor and Ezzorak and the Lightblinded Vanguard.
  • "Boss 6" are Crown of the Cosmos, Belo'ren, and Midnight Falls.

7.

Raid Rewards and Achievements

In addition to loot, participating in the Midnight Season 1 raids grants you various achievements, mounts, titles, and more. This section contains a breakdown of the most notable rewards you can grab in this raid tier.

7.1.

Glory of the Midnight Raider

Those who complete the Glory of the Midnight Raider meta-achievement will receive the Tenebrous Harrower mount.

Here are all the raid achievements you must earn to get the mount:

  • Nothing to See Here: Get consumed by the Devouring Host on the Voidspire or March on Quel'Danas raids.
  • Falling Between The Quacks: Defeat Chimaerus after plucking all Corrupted Feathers from Sergeant Quackers and rescuing him from the Aln in the Dreamrift on Normal difficulty or higher.
  • The Only Winning Move Is Not To Play: Defeat Imperator Averzian after causing him to destroy your banners in the Voidspire on Normal difficulty or higher.
  • Hungry Hungry Hatchlings: Defeat Vorasius after every player feeds a hatchling enough to put it to sleep in the Voidspire on Normal difficulty or higher.
  • It's Treason Then: Defeat Fallen-King Salhadaar after everyone /kneels to him before the battle starts in the Voidspire on Normal difficulty or higher.
  • Ready, Set, Snap!: Defeat Vaelgor & Ezzorak after all players break each Nullzone's tethers within 3 seconds in the Voidspire on Normal difficulty or higher.
  • Aura Farming: Defeat the Lightblinded Vanguard while your entire raid has Maximum Aura in the Voidspire on Normal difficulty or higher.
  • We Will, In Fact, See It Again: Defeat Crown of the Cosmos after slaying a Fleshy Monstrosity and returning all of its meat to The Emptiness in the Voidspire on Normal difficulty or higher.
  • Eggsistential Crisis: Defeat Belo'ren, Child of Al'ar after infusing the Sunwell Egg with Light and Void magic in March of Quel'Danas on Normal difficulty or higher.
  • All the Things She Said: Defeat Midnight falls after returning 12 memories of Alleria back to L'ura in March of Quel'Danas on Normal difficulty or higher.
7.2.

Midnight Falls Mount

There is one mount tied to Midnight Falls, the final encounter in March on Quel'Danas: Ashes of Belo'ren.

Ashes of Belo'ren drops from the Midnight Falls encounter on Mythic difficulty in March of Quel'Danas. Each Midnight Falls kill will drop 3 mounts until the release of the next WoW expansion, The Last Titan. By then, the mount will be reduced to a 1% drop.

7.3.

Sporefall Raid Rewards

Sporefall has a bunch of unique rewards from killing Rotmire. These are obtainable in all difficulties at a low drop chance:

  • The Luminous Sporeglider mount.
  • The Madcap Redcap toy, which summons a mushroom and allows friends to transform into sporelings.
  • The Mycomancer's Hearthspore toy, a sporeling-themed Hearthstone.
  • The Sporelord's Shroom Cap cosmetic, a mushroom Helm transmog.
7.4.

Midnight Season 1 Mythic Hall of Fame Achievements

In this raid tier, there are three Hall of Fame achievements. Each achievement requires players to be among the 200 guilds worldwide to defeat the final boss of each Midnight Season 1 raid on Mythic difficulty.

Sporefall does not have a Hall of Fame achievement.

  • Hall of Fame: Chimaerus, the Undreamt God: Among the first two hundred guilds worldwide to defeat Chimaerus, the Undreamt God on Mythic difficulty. Title reward: Famed Slayer of the Undreamt.
  • Hall of Fame: Crown of the Cosmos: Among the first two hundred guilds worldwide to defeat Crown of the Cosmos on Mythic difficulty. Title reward: Famed Slayer of the Voidspire.
  • Hall of Fame: Midnight Falls: Among the first two hundred guilds worldwide to defeat Midnight Falls on Mythic difficulty. Title reward: Famed Slayer of the Dark Naaru.
7.5.

Titles

Defeating Chimaerus in the Dreamrift on Mythic Difficulty ( Mythic: Chimaerus, the Undreamt God) rewards the Dream Eater title.

Defeating Crown of the Cosmos in the Voidspire on Mythic Difficulty ( Mythic: Crown of the Cosmos) rewards the Spirebane title.

Defeating Midnight Falls in March of Quel'danas on Mythic Difficulty ( Mythic: Midnight Falls) rewards the Dawnbringer title.

7.6.

Ahead of the Curve and Cutting Edge Midnight Season 1 Achievements

There are three Ahead of the Curve and Cutting Edge achievements in Midnight Season 1, one for each raid. Sporefall does not have an AOTC or CE achievement.

  • Ahead of the Curve: Chimaerus, the Undreamt God: Defeat Chimaerus, the Undreamt God in the Dreamrift on Heroic difficulty or higher, before the release of the next raid tier.
  • Ahead of the Curve: Crown of the Cosmos: Defeat Crown of the Cosmos in the Voidspire on Heroic difficulty or higher, before the release of the next raid tier.
  • Ahead of the Curve: Midnight Falls: Defeat Midnight Falls in March on Quel'Danas on Heroic difficulty or higher, before the release of the next raid tier.
  • Cutting Edge: Chimaerus, the Undreamt God: Defeat Chimaerus, the Undreamt God in the Dreamrift on Mythic difficulty, before the release of the next raid tier.
  • Cutting Edge: Crown of the Cosmos: Defeat Crown of the Cosmos in the Voidspire on Mythic difficulty, before the release of the next raid tier.
  • Cutting Edge: Midnight Falls: Defeat Midnight Falls in March on Quel'Danas on Mythic difficulty, before the release of the next raid tier.
8.

The Great Vault and Raid Slots

Great Vault requires you to defeat multiple raid bosses each week to unlock item choices in the Raids category. Our Great Vault guide has you covered with all the latest information for Midnight Season 1.
